title: Reconnect HTTP survives Front Door recycle
description:
As a household client, I want channel history, the turn journal, GET /turns/{id}, and GET /bots/{id} to survive Front Door recycle, so reconnect does not depend on an in-process Front Door.

These routes already work against Dynamo. This story puts recycle on the executable spec.

Feature: Channels and the message store
  Scenario: Channel history reconnects after a seq and a Front Door recycle
  Scenario: A turn can be read by identifier after a Front Door recycle

Feature: Turn-scoped server-sent events
  Scenario: Turn journal reconnects after a seq and a Front Door recycle

Feature: Bot turns pin to the user's computer
  Scenario: A bot can be read by identifier after a Front Door recycle

Not included: demo CLI, staging/production, merge to main, new routes.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Recycle Gherkin landed for channel history after=, turn journal after=, GET /turns/{id}, and GET /bots/{id} memory. No new routes. No ThinTurn redeploy (behavior already live). No staging/production. No merge to main.
